svg.title: Schema map (מפת סכמה)
svg.desc: Schema map, the big visual: tables as regions with soft header bands, relations as quiet muted routes, a join node and a selection node, the result table outlined in neon with a glowing entry point. Header bands are .45 (result .5) in light and .35 in dark via --rq-band-a and --rq-band-res-a, so the ink table names stay at 5.67:1 or more. Counts as one motif. Source: direction-board.html lines 414-441, 452.
